info.title: TripKing API
info.description: Outstation cab marketplace REST API. Wire format is snake_case; every response uses the envelope `{ success, data, meta?, error }` (meta on lists, error non-null on failure). This document currently covers the `/admin/*` master-data endpoints (Phase 2); the marketplace endpoints (`/auth`, `/trips`, `/drivers`, `/vacancies`, …) follow in Phase 3.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Administration master-data (the configurable lookup tables — see §7 of the spec).

tags.name: drivers
tags.description: Driver profiles + the "create my driver/agent profile" route.

tags.name: vacancies
tags.description: Driver availability posts (driver is in city X, willing to drive to one of these destinations).

tags.name: alerts
tags.description: Saved searches that fire a notification on a matching trip/vacancy (owner-scoped).

tags.name: analytics
tags.description: Server-computed analytics — the platform dashboard (admin), per-agent analytics, and the API-metrics rollup (admin).

tags.name: video-verifications
tags.description: Driver/manager video-call verification — slot booking, the call record, and the admin finalize.

tags.name: places
tags.description: Maps-backed locations — a server-side geocoder proxy (search) and find-or-create for a `places` row.

tags.name: debug
tags.description: Admin-only deliberate-failure endpoints — exercise the exception pipeline (front end / edge functions → Sentry). Safe to leave deployed. See docs/EXCEPTION_HANDLING.md.

ApiError.description: Returned inside the envelope's `error` on any non-2xx response. Every error — including unhandled exceptions — is delivered in this shape; an unhandled exception yields `{ code: "INTERNAL" }` with status 500 (never a raw runtime error) and is reported to Sentry (`source=edge-fn`).

code.description: Machine-readable code. Standard values: VALIDATION (400/422), UNAUTHORIZED (401), FORBIDDEN (403), NOT_FOUND (404), CONFLICT (409), RATE_LIMITED (429), DB_ERROR (4xx), INTERNAL (500). Some endpoints add specific codes (e.g. INVALID_OTP, BAD_JSON).

id.name: id
id.description: Row key — uuid for most lists, the `value` int for seat-options, the BCP-47 `code` for languages.

BearerAuth.description: Supabase access token from `POST /auth/verify-otp`. Authenticated endpoints validate it; every mutating `/admin/*` call additionally requires `users.role === 'admin'`.

get.summary: List a master-data list (active rows by default)

parameters.name: make_id
parameters.description: vehicle-models only — filter to a make

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: review-tags only — filter to a vocabulary

post.summary: Create a row

patch.summary: Update a row (partial; include `is_active` to enable/disable)

delete.summary: Delete a row — 409 `IN_USE` if it is referenced (disable it instead)

get.summary: Get the single-row platform config
Browse the geocoded places — admin tool for curating the `places` table (incl. inactive). Filters: city_id, provider, q (name ilike), active (true|false), limit.

patch.summary: Edit a place (admin) — is_active / city_id / name / formatted_address / state. Deactivate (is_active=false) instead of deleting if it's referenced.

delete.summary: Delete a place (admin) — 409 IN_USE if any *_place_id FK references it (deactivate or merge it instead).

post.summary: Merge (dedupe) — repoint every *_place_id FK from {id} (the loser) to {into} (the winner), then delete {id}. Atomic. Returns { merged, into, fk_rows_repointed }.
Request an SMS OTP — PLACEHOLDER (no SMS provider yet): always succeeds and returns the dev OTP "12345" in dev_otp
Verify an OTP → { user, access_token, refresh_token } (dev: accepts "12345" or any 4–6 digit code; role:admin is dev-only)
Exchange a refresh token for a new pair
Best-effort server logout (Bearer)

get.summary: The current user (Bearer)

List trips (Bearer required). Each trip is redacted to the caller's relationship: rows you posted → full (passenger name+phone, poster phone, the assigned driver's live position, distance_to_destination_km, passenger_otp); rows assigned to your driver profile → passenger name + poster phone + your own live position (passenger phone only when the trip's hide_passenger_phone is false); everything else → browse-safe (route/fare/car-type/pickup/passenger_count/applicant_count/posted_by_name/from_place/to_place — no passenger PII, no driver positions). status=in_progress&posted_by_user_id=<me> is a trip manager's live-trips map; assigned_driver_id=me is "the trips I'm driving". near_lat+near_lng+radius_km (all three; radius capped at 100km) restricts to trips whose pickup point (from_place → from_city fallback) is within range, nearest first, each row carrying distance_km.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: one value or a CSV (e.g. open,has_applicants)

parameters.name: assigned_driver_id
parameters.description: a driver uuid, or the literal "me" — resolves to the caller's driver profile (the trips assigned to you)

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: radius search — all three of near_lat/near_lng/radius_km must be present

post.summary: Post a trip (Bearer; the poster must be KYC-verified — 403 KYC_REQUIRED otherwise) — hide_passenger_phone (true|false) and passenger_count (≥1) are REQUIRED. from_place_id / to_place_id accepted alongside from_city_id / to_city_id (both coexist; *_place_id is the new primary path; a bad place id → 422). total_fare computed if omitted; driver_payout via trigger; matching active alerts get an alert_match notification. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).

hide_passenger_phone.description: whether to hide the passenger phone from the assigned driver (the poster always sees it)

get.summary: My applications (driver; Bearer) — the caller's own trip_acceptances, newest first, each with its joined trip (from/to city, car type). The poster-only GET /trips/{id}/applicants is for the other side; this is the driver's view of where they've applied. Empty array if the caller has no driver profile.

Get the trip for a passenger OTP (public — the OTP is the credential; the passenger portal). The passenger's own view: their data + the assigned driver (with live position + phone, to track/reach the ride) + vehicle; distance_to_destination_km when in_progress; fare fields nulled when show_fare_to_passenger is false; passenger_otp_hash / passenger_otp never echoed.

Get a trip (Bearer required) — redacted to the caller's relationship: the poster (or an admin) sees passenger name+phone, poster phone, the assigned driver's live position, distance_to_destination_km, and the plaintext passenger_otp (so they can re-open the passenger-portal link); the assigned driver sees passenger name + poster phone + their own live position (and passenger phone ONLY when the trip's hide_passenger_phone is false; never the OTP); anyone else sees browse-safe fields only (no passenger PII, no driver position). passenger_otp_hash is never returned.
List applicants (poster/admin; Bearer)

post.summary: Apply to a trip (driver; Bearer; must be KYC-verified — 403 KYC_REQUIRED otherwise) — per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess)
Reject an applicant (poster/admin; Bearer)
Assign a driver (poster/admin; Bearer) — selects one acceptance, rejects the rest, generates the passenger OTP
Start the trip (assigned driver/admin; Bearer) — verifies the passenger OTP → in_progress
Complete the trip (assigned driver/admin; Bearer)
Cancel the trip (poster/admin; Bearer)

get.summary: The caller's notifications (Bearer)

patch.summary: Mark a notification read (own only; Bearer)

post.summary: Mark all the caller's notifications read (Bearer)

get.summary: List vehicles (eligibility_status derived) — eligibility / needs_attention drive the admin eligibility dashboard

parameters.name: needs_attention
parameters.description: true ⇒ only vehicles whose eligibility_status ≠ eligible

post.summary: Add a vehicle (driver; Bearer) — driver_id = the caller

get.summary: Get a vehicle

patch.summary: Update a vehicle (owning driver/admin; Bearer) — include is_active to enable/disable

delete.summary: Delete a vehicle (owning driver/admin; Bearer) — 409 IN_USE if referenced

post.summary: Mint a short-lived signed PUT URL for one vehicle photo/paper (owning driver/admin; Bearer). Upload the bytes straight to Storage, then PATCH the returned column onto the vehicle.

get.summary: List driver profiles (public) — joins home/current city + vehicle summaries; kyc_status accepts a CSV (the admin KYC queue). When near_lat+near_lng+radius_km are all given, the list is restricted to drivers whose (non-stale, ≤30 min old) current position is within radius_km (capped at 100), nearest first, each row carrying distance_km.

parameters.name: kyc_status
parameters.description: one value or a CSV — e.g. docs_submitted,video_pending

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: radius search — all three of near_lat/near_lng/radius_km must be present

post.summary: Create my driver profile (Bearer; user_id = caller). Pass role=trip_manager to create an agent profile instead. Idempotent — returns the existing profile if one already exists.

get.summary: Get the caller's own driver profile (Bearer; joined like /drivers/{id}). 404 if the caller has no driver profile yet. Carries a server-computed `verification` block (kyc_status, per-step status, steps_done/steps_total, the scheduled video_verification, kyc_rejection_reason) for the owner.
Get a driver profile — the `verification` block + private KYC fields (masked Aadhaar, licence number/expiry) are returned only to the owner/admin; the public view is the coarse kyc_status

patch.summary: Update a driver profile (owner/admin; Bearer) — full_name, email, home_city_id, current_city_id, profile_photo_url
Update a driver's current location (owner; Bearer)
Move a driver through the KYC workflow (admin; Bearer) — records kyc_reviewed_by/at + kyc_rejection_reason (the `note`), and fires a kyc_status_change notification

post.summary: Mint a short-lived signed PUT URL for one KYC document (owner; Bearer). Upload the bytes straight to Storage, then call POST /drivers/{id}/kyc-docs with the returned path.

Submit a driver's KYC documents (owner; Bearer) — stores the Storage paths + the masked Aadhaar last-4 + licence number/expiry, sets kyc_docs_submitted_at, and moves kyc_status pending|resubmit_required → docs_submitted. Returns the driver profile.

get.summary: The driver's KYC documents — masked Aadhaar number, licence number/expiry, kyc_docs_submitted_at, and 5-minute signed download URLs for each file (owner or admin; Bearer)
List agent (trip-manager) profiles (public)

post.summary: Create my agent profile (Bearer; user_id = caller; users.role → trip_manager). Idempotent.

get.summary: Get the caller's own agent profile (Bearer; joined like /agents/{id}). 404 if the caller has no agent profile yet. Carries a server-computed `verification` block (3 steps — details, documents, video_call — plus steps_done/steps_total, the scheduled video_verification, kyc_rejection_reason) for the owner.
Get an agent profile (joins business city)

patch.summary: Update an agent profile (owner/admin; Bearer) — full_name, email, business_name, business_city_id, profile_photo_url
Move an agent through the KYC workflow (admin; Bearer) — records kyc_reviewed_by/at + kyc_rejection_reason (the `note`), and fires a kyc_status_change notification

post.summary: Mint a short-lived signed PUT URL for one agent KYC document (owner; Bearer) — no driving licence for trip managers. Upload the bytes straight to Storage, then call POST /agents/{id}/kyc-docs.

Submit an agent's KYC documents (owner; Bearer) — Aadhaar (front & back) + a selfie + the masked last-4 (no driving licence); sets kyc_docs_submitted_at and moves kyc_status pending|resubmit_required → docs_submitted. Returns the agent profile.

get.summary: The agent's KYC documents — masked Aadhaar number, kyc_docs_submitted_at, and 5-minute signed download URLs for Aadhaar front/back + selfie (owner or admin; Bearer)

List vacancies (public) — joins driver+vehicle summary, current_city/current_place, and destination cities + places (vacancy_destinations: [{ city, place }]). When near_lat+near_lng+radius_km are all given, restricted to vacancies whose current point (current_place → current_city fallback) is within radius_km (capped at 100), nearest first, each row carrying distance_km.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: radius search — all three of near_lat/near_lng/radius_km must be present

post.summary: Post a vacancy (driver; Bearer; must be KYC-verified — 403 KYC_REQUIRED otherwise) — driver_id = the caller; current_place_id accepted alongside current_city_id; destinations: [{ cityId?, placeId? }] (each entry may be a curated city, a precise place, or both — at least one id required; or the legacy parallel destination_place_ids / destination_city_ids) → vacancy_destinations rows (a bad place id → 422); matching active alerts get an alert_match notification. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).

get.summary: Get a vacancy

post.summary: Cancel a vacancy (owning driver/admin; Bearer)

get.summary: List my alerts (Bearer) — joins from/to city + from/to place

post.summary: Create an alert (Bearer; user_id = caller) — from_city_id required; from_place_id / to_place_id accepted alongside from_city_id / to_city_id (a bad place id → 422). Posting a trip/vacancy inside the alert's radius (and matching its other filters) fires an alert_match notification to the owner. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).

notify_via.description: only in_app is delivered today; push/sms/email are recorded but no-op. An alert that doesn't include in_app gets no notification yet.

get.summary: Get an alert (owner/admin; Bearer) — joins from/to city + from/to place

patch.summary: Update an alert (owner; Bearer) — partial; include from_place_id/to_place_id and/or is_active/paused_at to pause/resume (a bad place id → 422)

get.summary: List reviews (published rows + the caller's own when authed; admins see all). flagged=true (admin) = the moderation queue

parameters.name: flagged
parameters.description: admin only — return is_flagged rows (the moderation queue)

post.summary: Post a review (Bearer; rater_user_id = caller) — the trip must be completed; unique (trip_id, direction); ratee_user_id derived from the trip if omitted; fires a review_received notification. Per-user rate-limited (429 RATE_LIMITED on excess).
Report a review (any authed user; Bearer) — sets is_flagged + flag_reason
Moderate a review (admin; Bearer) — set is_published and/or clear the flag; records moderated_by/moderated_at

get.summary: Get a review (published, or own, or admin)

Platform dashboard (admin; Bearer) — server-computed counts/sums (users by role, drivers by KYC, vehicles by eligibility, trips by status, completed-fare/commission sums, flagged reviews, monthly trip series, …)
Agent analytics (Bearer) — the caller's own, or ?user_id=<id> for admins. Trips posted/by-status, fare totals, applicants received, unique drivers used, reviews received, a 6-month series.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: admin only — a specific agent's user id (defaults to the caller)

get.summary: API metrics rollup (admin; Bearer) — per-endpoint request count, error count (status >= 500), avg/max/p95 latency over the last `hours` (default 24, max 720), plus the window bounds.
List video-call verifications (admin; Bearer) — the Video Call Console. Each row joins its driver or manager summary.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: one value or a CSV of scheduled,completed,cancelled,no_show

post.summary: Book a video-call slot (driver or trip_manager whose kyc_status is docs_submitted; Bearer) — creates a video_verifications row (status scheduled, meeting_provider jitsi, meeting_url https://meet.jit.si/tripking-<id>) and moves the subject's kyc_status → video_pending. One open call per subject (409 otherwise). slot_at must come from /video-verifications/available-slots.

get.summary: Open 15-minute video-call slots (Bearer) — derived from admin availability windows; the next ~14 days, at least an hour out. Returns [{ slot_at, slot_minutes }].
Get a video-call verification (the subject, the conductor, or an admin; Bearer)

patch.summary: Cancel / reschedule / mark no-show (Bearer). Owner: { cancel: true } → cancelled (subject kyc_status → docs_submitted) or { reschedule_to: <ISO from available-slots> }. Admin: { no_show: true } → no_show (subject kyc_status → docs_submitted).

Finalize a video call (admin; Bearer) — sets status completed + conducted_by/at; moves the subject's kyc_status → approved | rejected | resubmit_required (records kyc_reviewed_by/at + kyc_rejection_reason from `notes`) and fires a kyc_status_change notification. outcome=approved requires face_match_confirmed && documents_confirmed && liveness_check_passed all true.

get.summary: Geocoder search (public) — server-side proxy to the configured provider (PLACES_PROVIDER + PLACES_API_KEY; biased to India). Does not persist. Per-IP rate-limited; responses carry Cache-Control. data is an array of { provider, providerPlaceId, name, formattedAddress, state, lat, lng }. Returns [] when the provider is unconfigured or upstream is unavailable; q shorter than 2 chars → [].

post.summary: Find-or-create a place (public) — match by (provider, providerPlaceId), else by a ~5dp lat/lng + provider match; otherwise insert. Returns the stored Place (snake_case row, incl. id). Per-IP rate-limited.

get.summary: List the debug routes (admin; Bearer) — data is { routes: [...] }

Deliberately throw an uncaught error (admin; Bearer) — withTiming reports it to Sentry (tags: source=edge-fn, fn=debug) and returns { code: "INTERNAL" } with status 500 (never a raw runtime error). Exercises the L5 edge-function error boundary.
Return a fail(code, …) envelope (admin; Bearer) — ?code=<CODE> picks the code (default CONFLICT) and a sensible HTTP status; no Sentry event.
Sleep then return 200 (admin; Bearer) — ?ms=<n> (default 1000, max 10000); data is { slept_ms }.
